EngLawName: Enforcement Rules of the National Health Insurance Data Management Act
LawName: 全民健康保險資料管理條例施行細則
EngLawHistories: 1.Promulgated on August 7,2026, in accordance with the Ministry of Health and Welfare Order Wei-Pu-Pao-Tzu No. 1151260376. Promulgation shall take effect on August 10, 2026.

EngLawArticles.EngArticleContent: Enforcement Rules of the National Health Insurance Data Management Act(hereinafter referred to as the “Enforcement Rules”) are promulgated pursuant to the provisions of Article 26 of the National Health Insurance Data Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”).

The term “information from which the identity of a specific individual may be identified” prescribed in Paragraph 1 of Article 14 of the Act includes information by which the individual may be directly identified, and information by which the individual may be indirectly identified after being compared, combined, linked with other data, or processed by other means.

Where an applicant submits a utilization results report to the competent authority or the Insurer pursuant to Paragraph 3 of Article 14 of the Act, the applicant shall do so within one year after the completion of the project.
The utilization results report referred to in the preceding paragraph shall include the project title, case number, and other matters designated by the competent authority or the Insurer.
Where an applicant publishes a written work concerning the utilization results , the applicant shall, within thirty days after publication of the work, provide the competent authority or the Insurer with the year and month of publication, the name of the journal, the names of the authors, and the title of the work.
The applicant shall, in the written work referred to in the preceding paragraph, indicate the source of the data or where the data are published, in the manner designated by the competent authority or the Insurer.
Where the Act requires a matter to be in writing, an electronic record may be used in accordance with the Electronic Signatures Act.
These Enforcement Rules shall take effect on  August 10, 2026.
